detail.body:
As part of #8489, this PR removes the obsolete `graph_harvesting` configuration and BF16 optimizer graph-capture path, rejects stale configurations with `DeepSpeedConfigError`, and updates the related tests and documentation. Hybrid Engine CUDA graph capture remains unchanged.

 @sfc-gh-truwase, could you please review when convenient? Thank you.
